newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Valiant and Barrick in jv.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Valiant and Barrick in jv.

text.p: Australian-based Valiant Consolidated Ltd said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement with Canada's Barrick Gold Corp to jointly explore highly prospective gold areas in the eastern Malaysian state of Sabah.

Valiant, a manganese miner and gold explorer, said Barrick would have an 80 percent stake and manage the joint venture and would free-carry Valiant's 20 percent interest for the first A$10 million of exploration expenditure.

"The agreement reflects Barrick's belief in the high prospectivity of Sabah and the island of Kalimantan and its potential to host major gold discoveries," Valiant managing director Simon Farrell said in a statement.
Farrell said the arrangment would allow Valiant to concentrate on its Western Australian manganese mining interests.
Both Valiant and Barrick had been conducting independent research and development work on gold exploration potential in Malaysia, he said.
Negotiations were currently underway with the Sabah state government for the granting of exploration licences, he said.
Valiant said the joint venture values its contribution to date at A$2.5 million.
After the initial expenditure of A$10 million, Valiant is required to contribute its 20 percent interest to exploration.
If it chooses not to contribute, Barrick can increase its interest to 95 percent by spending a total of A$47.5 million.

Valiant said Sabah is believed to host the northern extension of the Kalimantan gold belt and has the potential to host significant epithermal and sulphide gold deposits similar to those found in Indonesia.
